keyEvents.text: Goal! Eastleigh 0, Shrewsbury Town 1. George Lloyd (Shrewsbury Town) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Jay Turner-Cooke (Shrewsbury Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
